content_units: Kyoto Mid-April Weather Snapshot
Kyoto looks   best on Apr 11-12   for outdoor sightseeing.
Your least favorable days are   Apr 10 and Apr 13   due to much higher rain chances, with Apr 13 also being the windiest.
Kyoto Forecast and Best Time Picks
Day   Condition   Temp   Rain Chance   Wind   Humidity   UV   What to wear
Thu, Apr 10   Showery risk   18°C / 9°C   70%   14 km/h   Moderate   Moderate   Light layers; compact rain jacket
Fri, Apr 11   Mostly pleasant   21°C / 11°C   10%   8 km/h   Moderate   Moderate   Long sleeves + light outer layer
Sat, Apr 12   Mild and comfortable   23°C / 13°C   20%   10 km/h   Moderate   Moderate-High   Breathable layers; sunglasses
Sun, Apr 13   Wet and breezy   17°C / 8°C   80%   18 km/h   High   Low-Moderate   Waterproof layer; warmer top
Best two half-days for temple visits
-   1) Apr 11 morning   — best overall mix of mild temperature,   lowest rain risk  , and   lightest wind  ; ideal for longer temple grounds walks.
-   2) Apr 12 morning   — slightly warmer but still very comfortable, with low rain risk and light wind; great for temple gardens and outdoor corridors.
Best evening for a riverside walk
-   Apr 11 evening   — the calmest and driest option overall, so it should feel the most pleasant along the river.
- Trade-off alternative:   Apr 12 evening   if you prefer a slightly warmer feel, though rain risk is a bit higher than Apr 11.
Temple Visit Comfort Guide
Top choice: Apr 11
- Best match for your priorities:   mild  ,   dry  , and   light wind  .
- Strong pick for temples with open grounds such as Kiyomizu-dera, Ginkaku-ji approach areas, or garden-focused visits.
Second choice: Apr 12
- Warmest day and still fairly low rain risk.
- Best if you like a softer spring feel, but midday may feel a little warmer than your ideal “mild” range.
Less suitable
-   Apr 10:   workable only with rain gear; higher shower risk could interrupt outdoor walking.
-   Apr 13:   least suitable for relaxed sightseeing due to   80% rain   and stronger wind.
Packing for Kyoto, Apr 10-13
-   Light waterproof jacket or packable rain shell
-   Long-sleeve tops   and   T-shirts for layering
-   Light sweater or cardigan   for cool mornings/evenings
-   Comfortable walking shoes  , preferably water-resistant
-   Compact umbrella
-   Light scarf   or extra layer for Apr 13
-   Sunglasses   for Apr 11-12
-   Small day bag   for layers as temperatures shift through the day
Best clothing strategy
- Use   spring layers  : breathable base + light outer layer.
- Plan for   cool starts  , pleasant afternoons, and at least   one rainy day outfit  .
